- scripts/claude_checker_restart.py:439-441 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `_project_trigger` matching logic `wanted.startswith(stem)` is flawed for Routine names truncated after the `wanted` prefix.
  WHY: If a Routine name is truncated as `implement-plan issue-7: check-in...` (stem `implement-plan issue-7: check-in`), the matching logic `wanted.startswith("implement-plan issue-7: check-in")` returns False. The guard fails to recognize the existing trigger and may create a duplicate restart trigger for an already-monitored project.
- scripts/claude_checker_restart.py:554 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fetch for open `ai:claude` issues is not paginated (`per_page=100`, no `paginate=True`).
  WHY: In repositories with more than 100 open `ai:claude` issues, the pickup will only see the first page, causing it to ignore any issues beyond the first 100 and leave their checkers un-monitored.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- File: .claude/settings.json (workflow-templates twin) lines 55-64, 97-103, 111-117, plus .claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md step 3b
  Code reference: new allow rules `Bash(python3 scripts/claude_checker_restart.py {scan,decide} *)` and `Bash(PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/claude_checker_restart.py {scan,decide} *)`, the new `mcp__Claude_Code_Remote__set_session_tags` (and the generated-server twin), and the new `mcp__github__add_issue_comment` already present in the root file (line 70) and now exercised by step 3b.6.
  Problem: The pickup gains two new capability scopes (`set_session_tags` on arbitrary cloud sessions and posting arbitrary issue comments via `mcp__github__add_issue_comment`), gated solely by what `scripts/claude_checker_restart.py` decides to print.
  Why it fails at runtime: A future script bug that emitted a wrong checker id would cause the pickup to tag an unintended session and post a `/reclarify` comment on the wrong issue. The blast radius is bounded (`set_session_tags` is add/remove tags only — no session deletion or archival; `add_issue_comment` is comment-only — no label or state mutation), and the script's fail-safe checks (5 restart conditions, 6 requeue guards, all reads fail-open and feed `errors[]`) cap the risk. No additional invocation guard or kill switch is added; the pickup reports failures but does not retry within the wake, so a one-shot bug is contained to that wake.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
